findings: The zero-model time-source probe passes on the fixed host with zero live writes and a complete identity/idempotency/pause/clock matrix.

The checkpoint availability probe returns ready:false with CHECKPOINT_STAGING_UNCONFIGURED, GOAL_SESSION_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE and MEMORY_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE, correctly enumerates 3 active Goal bindings and writes no files.
The worker and core mount probes still return exactly their expected restricted surfaces with no authority fields and zero counters.

The bounded real-model core event-tool probe reached the host and returned an honest structured failure (protocol violation, zero model requests) with full cleanup; no model cost was incurred and no retry was made. The real-model tool round therefore remains unverified.
schema4 publication, channels projection and capability definitionDigest remain truthful; no business fact was written by any probe.

evidence.relativePathEncoding: Session relative paths retain the host-encoded project directory name (e.g. --Users-caja-...--); they contain no absolute path, no message body and no secret; future exports should redact them.
evidence.sanitizedAudits: The committed round4-host-*.json audits differ from their .local originals only by replacing the local home/data-root path with <home>; no other field was altered.

limitations: The bounded real-model single-round tool probe failed before any model request and is not retried; no real-model tool invocation, provider usage, cache or cost is proven.

Zero-model evidence only for the mount/time/checkpoint probes; live time triggering (rules in the live control DB), checkpoint capture readiness, real Session export and real Ombre export remain untested.
The archived core-model probe Session ended with a blocked turn before any assistant message; its root cause inside the host agent loop is not investigated further in this slice.
Real browser DOM rendering of the dashboard remains unproven; lifecycle=degraded still reflects retained historical facts.
